Title: MemorySmith.Agent — SteveBot MCP Endpoint Verified Baseline
Content:
## Overview

Verified the local MemorySmith.Agent MCP endpoint and live tool inventory using the repo-local key. Documents the non-destructive route behavior and current caveats.

## Verified Endpoints (as of 2026-07-10)

| Endpoint | Status | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| `GET /health` | 200 Healthy | Basic health check |
| `GET /api/health/live` | 200 Healthy | Liveness probe |
| `GET /api/health/ready` | 200 Ready | Readiness probe |
| `GET /api/diagnostics` | 401 Unauthorized | Requires authenticated access |

## MCP Tool Inventory

Both `GET /mcp` and `POST /mcp` (JSON-RPC) return the live tool catalog. Verified tool names:

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `memorysmith_search` | Search memories by text query |
| `memorysmith_hybrid_search` | Hybrid (vector + lexical) search |
| `memorysmith_context_pack` | Build agent-ready context packs |
| `memorysmith_get` | Get a single memory record by ID |
| `memorysmith_code_search` | Search indexed code files |
| `memorysmith_code_search_status` | Check code search index status |
| `memorysmith_page_search` | Search wiki pages |
| `memorysmith_page_get` | Get a single wiki page by slug |
| `memorysmith_task_list` | List tasks with filters |
| `memorysmith_task_get` | Get a single task by ID |

### JSON-RPC Methods Supported

- `initialize` — capability negotiation
- `ping` — keepalive / liveness
- `tools/list` — enumerate available tools

## Caveats & Known Limitations

- Use the repo-local `X-Api-Key` from `.vscode/mcp.json` for live route probes
- The semantic-search fallback path remains limited because the ONNX embedding model is not currently present in this repo
- Tool names documented here are verified from live endpoint; always check the live endpoint before coding against tool names
- The MCP endpoint is scoped to `MemorySmith.Agent` local memory/docs/tasks surfaces only
- The `MemorySmith.Agent` REST API runs alongside the Blazor dashboard in a single process

## Usage

- Use these verified tool names when coding MCP client code or writing tests
- Update this memory when the MCP tool catalog changes (new tools added, renamed, or removed)
- MCP configuration is in `.vscode/mcp.json` (repo-local key with `X-Api-Key` header)

## Key Source Files

| File | Location |
|------|----------|
| MCP endpoint | `WebUI.Blazor/Controllers/McpController.cs` |
| Health controller | `WebUI.Blazor/Controllers/HealthController.cs` |
| MCP config | `.vscode/mcp.json` |
